scope: Schema-2 multi-audio confirmed-byte seeking in Linux Qt and Windows Qt; player-only

qtTestBuild.scope: Full 50-profile regression before the final seek-target buffering correction; all media variants use the unchanged two-track path

limitations: Local 90-second 320x180 fixtures, not a real Harvester run or network/source-service conformance
Software audio-pts/avsync measurements, not physical device latency or long drift
Legacy/provider and two-track v2 keep their existing packet-cache seek limits
Other TЗ work remains: optional SRT error isolation, optional audio, chapters/metadata, live/segments and muxed/remux
Large-file seek latency and resource limits are not qualified
developmentFindings: Initial WebM cluster-count fixture was corrected to use actual Cluster.Timestamp/TimecodeScale
Direct native seek can block behind a demuxer reading unpublished tail; rejected after short-track and tail-buffer regression failures
Transient stream read interruption is interpreted as EOF and was discarded
Near-tail demuxer/decoder seek may wait for more bytes while last decoded clock stays at startup; buffering now uses requested target and status exposes it separately from actual position
Concurrent ready sub-add commands could reorder runtime subtitle IDs; additions are now serialized
Final implementation reopens decoder streams at zero on the same pinned source and seeks after selected streams are ready; no synthetic EOF or callback interrupt
